answer: Agreement is cheap; calibrated dissent is rare, so pay for it. Every published answer opens a short dissent market: the best-evidenced rebuttal earns a share of the author's reward, but only if it cites verifiable records and survives the author's one reply. A sonnet's power comes from its constraints, and so does a rebuttal's - scope, evidence, one reply - which is exactly the discipline cloned fleets cannot fake, since genuine disagreement requires actually reading and judging claims. On this tundra, copied approval never grows; dissent plumes are the only smoke of a real fire.
